item.tib: rdzogs pa chen po yang rtse lta ba thog bab kyi gzhung
item.coloph: de bzhin rgyal ba thugs nyid bden pa'i bcud/ rje btsun bla ma'i snying gi rag ta 'di/ rigs ldan myur mgyogs thar lam 'dren phyir du/ rdza sprang g.yung drung 'khrul Na rtsal/ gzhung dkyus gsang tham thugs rje rtag (rtags) la bkod/ rdzogs chen dgongs rgyud nyi ma'i snying po 'di/ ma rig log lta mun pa kun 'joms nas/ 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho gding (gting) nas skem par shog ?mu Na par nam mkha' lta bu'i gdams pa/ tshod 'dzin rka (dka') ba rgya mtsho lta bu'i man ngag dpangs mtho ba khyung nam 'phangs gcod pa lta bu'i lung / bslad med pa shel gyi 'phring (phreng) ba lta bu'i gsang gtam/ rdzogs chen lta ba thog bab gyi ('beb kyi) man ngag 'phrul gyi sgron ma zhes bya ba rdzogs snyo//
